prompt: Read request.txt and turn the ambiguous checkout request into requirements.json with arrays named functional_requirements, non_functional_requirements, assumptions, and acceptance_criteria. Do not implement the feature.
selection_reason: Structured requirements output is deterministic and has nearby planning distractors.

prompt: Reconcile the conflicting statements in sources/a.md and sources/b.md. Write decision.json containing claims, conflicts, chosen_source, and rationale; cite the source filename for every claim.
selection_reason: Evidence reconciliation distinguishes source-grounded work from generic research.

prompt: Using model-card.md and samples.jsonl, write training-plan.json with dataset_split, objective, hyperparameters, evaluation, and rollback fields for adapting the small language model without exposing the held-out examples.
selection_reason: Concrete training plan has machine-checkable structure and ML distractors.

prompt: Complete src/scene.js so it creates a perspective camera, renderer, lit rotating cube, resize handler, and animation loop. Preserve the exported createScene(container) API.
selection_reason: Three-dimensional scene requirements separate the target from timeline and two-dimensional animation guidance.

prompt: Fix src/Hero.jsx so the heading animation is scoped to the component, cleaned up on unmount, and safe under React Strict Mode. Keep the existing markup and export.
selection_reason: React lifecycle constraints distinguish the integration skill from core and timeline variants.

prompt: Design the retry-safe HTTP contract described in brief.md. Produce openapi.yaml with create, fetch, and cancel operations, a reusable error schema, authentication, and an idempotency header on creation.
selection_reason: Contract design is distinct from framework implementation but has close backend distractors.

prompt: Implement the missing routes and validation in src/server.js. The service must reject malformed items, return 201 for valid creation, and expose a not-found response matching the tests.
selection_reason: Framework-specific fixture competes with general backend and another Node framework.

prompt: Repair src/retrieve.py so queries are chunked, embedded once per unique text, ranked by cosine similarity, and returned with source citations. Make all existing tests pass.
selection_reason: Retrieval pipeline has an objective implementation and nearby ML/data distractors.

prompt: Finish the static product page in public/ so it has semantic header, main, three feature sections, a visible call-to-action, responsive navigation, and no horizontal overflow at 375px.
selection_reason: End-to-end page construction competes with narrower visual design guidance.

prompt: Complete the infrastructure module under module/. Pin the provider, validate the bucket_name input, enable encryption, expose the bucket identifier, and make the supplied static checks pass.
selection_reason: Declarative infrastructure work has cloud and deployment distractors with deterministic static checks.

prompt: Use service-metrics.md to write observability.yaml defining availability and latency objectives, burn-rate alerts for fast and slow windows, and dashboard panels. Include an owner and runbook for every alert.
selection_reason: SLO/alert configuration distinguishes observability from general cloud operations.

prompt: Repair the development and production build configuration. Environment values must use the documented client prefix, /api must proxy locally, and the legacy chunk must be split into its own output. Make the config checks pass.
selection_reason: Build-tool configuration is objective and has broad frontend distractors.

prompt: Fix the worker pool so cancellation stops new work, every started goroutine exits, errors retain their cause, and tests pass under the race detector. Do not change the public API.
selection_reason: Language-specific concurrency semantics distinguish it from generic backend work.

prompt: Audit the supplied page and write audit.json with technical_issues, on_page_changes, structured_data, and measurement. Then update public/index.html to add the missing canonical, description, and machine-readable product data.
selection_reason: Search-specific technical edits compete with messaging and growth guidance.

prompt: Turn brief.md into messaging.json with customer, problem, guide, plan, call_to_action, failure, and success. Keep each value grounded in the brief and make the customer—not the company—the central actor.
selection_reason: A fixed narrative framework has clear fields and close persuasion distractors.

prompt: Replace the flaky login browser test with resilient selectors and state-based waiting, add a page object, and configure trace capture on first retry. The supplied structural checks must pass; do not add fixed sleeps.
selection_reason: Browser-test conventions are automatically inspectable and have generic testing/frontend distractors.
